0022600229.text: The Timberwolves (8-3, 4-1 at home) host the Dallas Mavericks (7-4) in Minnesota's 12th game of the season. Minnesota sits 2nd in the Northwest, 0.5 games back, and enters on a four-game winning streak with a 7-3 record over its last ten, while Dallas is 4th in the Southwest, 1.5 games back, on a three-game streak and also 7-3 over its last ten. Minnesota is without Anthony Edwards (knee, surgery), who is averaging 33.3 points and 33.7 minutes per game this season, and Donte DiVincenzo (Achilles, surgery), while Dallas is missing Dereck Lively II (foot, surgery), Sergio de Larrea (knee strain), and Tarik Biberovic (heel inflammation), with Morez Johnson Jr. listed as day-to-day with a leg issue and a game-time decision. The teams have not played each other yet this season, but the Timberwolves won the 2025-26 season series 4-0, including a 124-94 win in Dallas on March 30, 2026.
